Rack Unit Editors

Browser editors and librarians for MIDI rack units, laid out like each unit's front panel.

Korg A2
Performance Signal Processor · 100 programs, 97 chains OPEN → Marshall JMP-1
Valve MIDI pre-amp · 100 patches and MIDI mapping OPEN →

Needs a browser with Web MIDI and SysEx (Chrome, Edge or Opera). The browser asks for MIDI access when you connect. Without MIDI you can still load and save .syx files. Your data stays in your browser. Tested against simulated units only, not hardware yet. Source code: github.com/alexpilotti/webmidi-rackgear-editors.
